newsitem.title: UK: BFI up 10 more points on firm fixings.
newsitem.headline: BFI up 10 more points on firm fixings.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index repeated Wednesday's 10-point increase to be set at 1,054 points on Thursday as brokers reported sharp increases in the Panamax grain trades.
Continental were reported to have fixed Ascension 50,000 tonnes heavy grain US Gulf to Aqaba for Oct 16/19 at $18.50 (up $3 from charterers previous fixture).

Dreyfus was said to have fixed 52,000/54,000 heavy grain NoPac to Japan at $11.30 basis no combination and Hanjin took a Cosco vessel Full Comfort for 54,000 heavy grain US Gulf to Japan for Nov 13/23 at $20.50 no combination.
Market rumours suggest $21.00 has been bid today for early November US Gulf to Japan, up from $20.00 fixed two day's ago by MOSK for this position with C.Yalikoy.
Brokers said slightly better conditons were reported in the Caper market and some stronger rates for Handies have been fixed from the US Gulf for grain and fertilisers.
At 1200 GMT BIFFEX was four to 10 points up reflecting the stronger fixings and turnover totalled 59 lots.
